features.title: Reject unprotected audit snapshots before agent spend
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/security-audit-snapshot.md. Actual permission bits must be checked after export before metadata publication. Preserve source bytes, budget refusal, owned cleanup, all prior tests and source-only limits. No target code or provider execution.
acceptance: Pass six frozen independent cases, including actual Linux and Windows-mounted mode observations.
Init refuses a snapshot that fails inspection before metadata/stage publication; exact export tree is checked.
No mode inspection result is represented as arbitrary same-user containment or tool isolation.

features.title: Reject static symlink ancestors in audit snapshot paths
features.description: Close the independently reviewed exported inspector path gap under spec/contracts/security-audit-root-path.md. Preserve SA-01 and all existing tests. No race, capture, target execution or provider work.
acceptance: Three reviewed static fixtures pass: ancestor symlink refusal, explicit dot component refusal, canonical trailing-separator control.
Inspect ancestors without following symlinks before subtree enumeration; preserve original init gating and diagnostic vocabulary.

features.title: Persist individual audit dispatch intent and returned results
features.description: Implement the journal contract only; actual private ownership, per-row durable transitions and conservative unknown replay. Keep existing audit metadata and upstream validators unchanged. No providers, crash-lock takeover, process-race or capture reproduction.
acceptance: Pass fourteen frozen ordinary journal cases and preserve all existing gates.
Persist dispatched state before callback and terminal result before returning; completed results replay without callback; uncertain calls stay held.
Finite per-record and aggregate bounds support more than 1 MiB combined payload; unsafe input/identity/path refuses without adoption.
Clearly retain lack of abnormal-process lock recovery until its later reviewed integration.

features.title: Bind journal reads and bound stored payloads before allocation
features.description: Correct reviewed J1/J2 only under the journal-read contract. Preserve journal API, owning lease, per-record and total limits, all existing tests and unknown-call accounting. No large database, capture, race or provider reproduction.
acceptance: Three ordinary reader consistency cases pass; changed valid current identity refuses CONFLICT and exact restoration preserves receipts.
Independent static review verifies every variable-width stored row field is size-bounded and aggregate capacity checked before materialization; exact logical accounting remains afterward.
Existing journal and full host gates remain unchanged; tests do not claim hostile identity or filesystem-race protection.

features.title: Preserve original workflow schemas through native JSON output
features.description: Implement only the pure shared native schema contract. Preserve all six graph schemas, vendored validators and existing hunt converter. No runtime, provider, filesystem or installer changes.
acceptance: Pass fifteen frozen pure schema cases.
Preserve optional omission, explicit null unions and open records without coercion or field loss.
Reject unsupported schemas and unsafe non-JSON values before executing hooks or Proxy traps; bound bytes, depth and diagnostics.
Fixed strict JSON-string wire envelope decodes once and validates the original schema.

features.title: Publish readable partial audit reports from durable checkpoints
features.description: Implement partial context, renderer, content-addressed publisher and freshness reader in the existing report owner. Preserve final report behavior and all audit authority bytes; unavailable evidence remains unknown. This helper slice does not claim native callback control integration.
acceptance: Eleven ordinary partial-report cases pass using owning fixtures and journal API.
Retain pending lead identities, distinguish raw transport results from validated dispositions, and bind every rendered input.
Publish immutable generations and pointer last; stale, invalid or unavailable evidence cannot be reported current.
Output failures preserve completed receipts and allow rendering-only recovery; actual no-new-dispatch gate is a later mandatory integration.

features.title: Execute trusted workflows through bounded native callback ports
features.description: Implement the pinned six-template registry and shared native executor only. Preserve graph logic, original schemas, provider uncertainty, nested concurrency, durable replay and independent permission profiles. Fake ports only; no provider, installer migration or existing native hunt/autobuild rewrite.
acceptance: Nineteen frozen ordinary/pure cases exercise actual trusted QA, dev-child, release refusal and audit workflows.
Nested workflows share one concurrency cap without parent permit deadlock; call identities are stable and binding conflicts refuse replay.
Durable checkpoint or transport uncertainty escapes graph catches; deadlines and abort bound pending operations and prevent late dispatch.
Use original NR-01 schema validation, exact transport receipts, explicit profile refusal and no model/provider fallback.

features.title: Persist opt-in audit grant controls and report freshness barriers
features.description: Implement C1 journal controls only. C2 native reserve policy and runtime draining remain separately required. Preserve legacy v1 semantics and owning lease; bounded explicit v2 opt-in, immutable maximum, CAS increases only while paused/quiescent, reserved settlement capacity and current owning report acknowledgement.
acceptance: Nine ordinary cases pass, including zero authorized grant and maximum as known values.
Unknown outcomes and stale reports block new admission; terminal settlement and replay remain possible within reserved capacity.
Actual budget evidence binds partial-report generations without acknowledgement cycles; no native verification-reserve enforcement claim yet.

features.title: Provide bounded manifest-scoped source and context reads
features.description: Implement source-reader library only with existing path grammar and finite JSON utilities. Static root/ancestor/file protections, exact full-file hashes and bounded lossless pages; no provider, MCP, target execution or filesystem-race proof.
acceptance: Eight reviewed ordinary/pure cases pass for source/context separation, pagination, literal byte search and complete hash verification.
No arbitrary filesystem roots, path traversal, static symlinks, writable artifacts or unlisted reads accepted.
Reader integrity is not Git provenance, runtime tool confinement or hostile concurrent replacement proof.

features.title: Reject statically aliased source/context roots by directory identity
features.description: Correct SR-ROOT-ALIAS-01: retain frozen SR01 lexical/path/mode/hash boundaries and add exact reliable bigint directory identities across opposite root ancestor chains. Pure metadata validation; no actual Windows/DrvFS alias, race or containment claim.
acceptance: Four serial ordinary/pure cases pass: distinct siblings share parents; identical root identities and opposite-chain overlap refuse; unusable identities fail closed.
No lossy Number/lowercase/realpath-only identity inference. Preserve all frozen SR01 tests and baseline gates.
Pure substituted metadata tests prove decision predicates only; no previously blocked filesystem or capture reproduction.

features.title: Partition full critic evidence and require global semantic reconciliation
features.description: Implement pure partition planner and narrow optional context in owning security-audit graph. Use exact executable arguments and real serializer measurement; preserve legacy behavior when context absent. No durable scheduling or existing clipping test amendments in this slice.
acceptance: Five cases pass, including 122-unit full evidence exceeding historical failed prompt size and each generated script at most 500000 bytes.
Retain every linked evidence value and require all partitions plus global reconciliation before pure completion; global cannot erase pending proposals.
Actual graph prompts distinguish partition scope and global cross-subsystem review while preserving upstream schema and source-only frame.
Durable manifests, production full-evidence adapter, reader wiring and reserve integration remain mandatory later work.

features.title: Inventory every offering and distinguish visibility from native readiness
features.description: Implement offline catalog/discovery/preflight projection only. Preserve Claude installer and use existing settings resolver. Historical inventory plus new native-runtime shared library; all offered workflows and ancillary assets remain explicitly uncertified until their runtime gates pass.
acceptance: Eight offline cases compare exact current offering, workflow, asset, fixed target and SKILL content sets.
Static linked/copy/drift/missing/wrong-target visibility remains distinct from native support; source reads require canonical containment.
Auth, account, payer and runtime observations remain unknown; no ready claim, provider call or installer mutation.

features.title: Connect native audit checkpoints with actual owners, controlled pauses and cooperative cancellation
features.description: Implement actual native journal/report bridge and narrowly selected NR02 pause and reserve-signal extension. Preserve existing frozen contracts/tests and fatal precedence. No alternate scheduler, provider, grant bypass or previously blocked reproduction.
acceptance: Nine ordinary actual-owner fixtures pass using existing trusted graphs and inert provider ports.
Actual freshness precedes authorization; durable terminal receipts survive controlled publication failure and same invocation resumes without repeated callbacks.
Concurrent controlled pause drains authorized siblings; external cancellation joins only owned deferred callbacks and retains uncertain charges.
Owner association rejects forged, Proxy, closed and mismatched handles before hooks. No real provider, hostile filesystem containment or C2 reserve-policy claim.

features.title: Expose per-record lifecycle feedback and deliver legal critic transitions
features.description: Reuse owning unitFromInput and vendored validation. Preserve valid sibling input bytes, reject lifecycle null/empty rather than normalize identity, and provide shared legal transition vocabulary in actual critic prompts and partition/global hashes. Retry application remains separate.
acceptance: Ten ordinary/pure cases pass with unchanged original validators and frozen gates.
Accepted sibling records retain original bytes and identity; all duplicate slots reject; no partial run publication.
Deferred units remain non-reopenable; malformed transition context dispatches nobody.
Actual criticInput, graph prompt and partition/global planner use shared owner context, bound before hash and unchanged500000-byte measurement.
